understand.title: Understand the problem
understand.description: Frame the problem before designing: assumptions, objects, decisions, strategy, and priorities.

research.title: Research and synthesize
research.description: Plan, run, and synthesize research: screeners, test guides, synthesis, insights, and share-outs.

shape.title: Shape the experience
shape.description: Shape interaction, content, motion, accessibility, and responsive behaviour.

build.title: Build and prototype
build.description: Build screens on real design tokens and components, and keep Figma and code in sync.

review.title: Review and validate
review.description: Critique and check work before sharing: UX patterns, accessibility, live pages, and audits.

handoff.title: Explain and hand off
handoff.description: Explain decisions and hand work off: rationale, handoff specs, reports, decks, and writing.

operate.title: Run the design practice
operate.description: Run the practice around the work: setup, memory, debt, scheduling, tickets, and team coaching.
